subject: Urgent: latency guardrail override request for bespoke Elara pilot
messages:
From: Anna Davies <anna.davies@elara.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@elara.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latency & uptime guarantees for Elara pilot

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Elara is moving quickly: the procurement committee has asked for explicit commitments on latency and uptime for the pilot so we can greenlight engineering integration next week. Our asks are: 99.99% monthly uptime SLA (US region) and a P95 latency guarantee of 50ms for token-level inference during the pilot (peak traffic expected in our west coast region).

We understand this is tighter than standard terms; we are prepared to:
- commit to a 6 month paid pilot (~$90k MRR equivalent) if we can get the guarantees in writing
- sign an MOA with monitoring hooks and an agreed remediation cadence

Attached is a short SLA proposal (SLA_Remedies_Elara_v1.pdf) with proposed service credit language. Procurement timeline: we need a signed MOA by Friday to meet our board deadline. Can Redwood accelerate an exception review?

Appreciate a quick call if helpful — Anna

--
Anna Davies
Head of Platform Integrations, Elara Therapeutics
anna.davies@elara.com
+1 415-555-0148
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Davies <anna.davies@elara.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latency & uptime guarantees for Elara pilot

Anna —

Appreciate the clarity and the aggressive timeline. Looping in Marissa and the deal desk team to evaluate an exception. Quick summary from our side after an initial run-rate check: 99.99% + P95 50ms is outside our standard public commitments for multi-tenant hosted plans. We can support a private-dedicated pattern that gets closer, but there are trade-offs (cost and lead time).

Proposed operational alternative for exec review (shortened):
- Pilot duration: 90 days (paid)
- Uptime: 99.95% (US region)
- Latency: P95 target 200ms (with monitoring and a remediation SLO to aggressively reduce tail)
- Remedies: tiered service credits capped at 5% monthly invoice per qualifying incident; escalation path and 24/7 on-call during pilot
- Commercials: one-time onboarding credit ($75k) + time-limited subscription discount (proposed 20% for pilot term)

This gets us most of the customer's reliability needs while limiting long-tail financial exposure. I attached an internal risk memo (internal_sla_risk_memo.pdf) that outlines potential operational gaps and suggested mitigations (prefix caching, dedicated shard, increased KV cache retention).

If the customer insists on 99.99% / P95 50ms, we'll need to present a dedicated-private deployment pricing and a legal carveout on unlimited credits. Marissa / Vivek — can you advise if we should seek executive signoff for a one-off exception to 99.95 / capped credits instead of the customer's ask?

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: latency & uptime guarantees for Elara pilot — exec approval request

Aditya / Vivek —

Forwarding Jonas's note and the customer's SLA proposal. Elara is strategic (pipeline >$1M ARR over 18 months, strong reference potential in biopharma). Procurement is pushing for 99.99% and 50ms P95 during pilot which we cannot safely guarantee on standard hosted capacity without substantial concessions.

Recommendation for executive exception (we need sign-off today to hit Elara's board deadline):
1) Approve a limited, documented exception for the pilot: grant 99.95% uptime (US) and P95 200ms, for a 12-week pilot only
2) Cap service credits at 3% of monthly invoice per qualifying incident; aggregate annual cap of 6% of MRR for the pilot/account for the 12 month window
3) Commercial offset: 10% subscription discount for the pilot term and a $75k onboarding credit (to be recovered via renewal ramp)
4) Require a 30-day technical readiness gate (metrics-based) prior to granting full SLA — metrics to be agreed in MOA and instrumented by Red/Elara engineers
5) Legal to add explicit clause limiting remedies for non-covered failure modes and require monthly operational reviews

If approved I'll instruct Deal Desk to prepare the MOA and commercial terms and get Legal and Security into the loop. I think this gives Elara enough comfort while protecting our exposure — lower credit cap than Jonas's initial proposal and a smaller discount.

Asking for a yes / no and any changes before I send the MOA to procurement.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: latency & uptime guarantees for Elara pilot — exec approval request

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the concise recommendation. I approve a one-time exception on the following terms (final, non-negotiable unless finance/legal authorizes otherwise):

- Grant for pilot only (90 days): 99.95% monthly uptime (US) and P95 latency target 200ms.
- Service credits: capped at 3% of monthly invoice per qualifying incident; maximum aggregate exposure 6% of MRR over a 12-month lookback window.
- Commercials: grant a 10% subscription discount for the pilot and a $75k onboarding credit. Do not exceed 10% discount.
- Conditions: require a 30-day readiness gate with agreed telemetry (we must own the tracing hooks), mandatory weekly operational sync during the pilot, and a signed MOA that includes a carveout for third-party infra failures.
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated or isolated pool for Elara; if customer chooses multi-tenant hosted, require additional surge capacity reservation and a pass-through surcharge.
- Legal: include explicit language limiting cumulative credits and require pre-approval from Legal for any amendment.

Marissa — please move forward with MOA and loop Legal + Security. Jonas — notify the customer and prepare the technical readiness checklist; escalate any resistance on pricing back to me. I'll review the MOA before signatures.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
CRO | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
